summary: The requirement document describes a maintenance system for two auto-component plants with 320 machines. It replaces paper breakdown slips and Excel history with machine records, work orders, preventive schedules, a technician Android app, spare-parts stock, sensor alerts, failure prediction and dashboards, connected to SAP for purchasing. Support is needed for two years after go-live.

evidence.quote: Operators shall raise a breakdown request by scanning the QR code on the machine with a phone.

stories: As an operator, I can raise a breakdown request by scanning the QR code on a machine

evidence.quote: Technicians shall use an Android app to see and update their work orders, take photos and follow checklists.
